_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Ame siwo le agbalẽa ƒe Snake le {width}×{height} agbalẽa me.
Wo kontrola snake {player_id}. Nuŋɔŋlɔ siwo wɔa: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (alo w/s/a/d).
Xexlẽme: ku ƒe agbalẽa siwo le agbalẽa me alo wo le agbalẽa siwo le agbalẽa me kple wo ku ƒe agbalẽa siwo le agbalẽa me (xexlẽme {max_turns} siwo le agbalẽa me).

board.after_moves: Dukɔ si me Dɔdzikpɔhaa le fifia: {board}

outcome.survived_win: Fefewɔla {player_id} tsi agbe; ame susɔeawo katã ku.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Daawo katã ku le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me.
outcome.outlived: Player nɔ agbe wu ame bubuawo katã.
outcome.turn_limit: Ne wotrɔ asi le eŋu wòde akpa ɖeka dzi la, woaɖo eƒe teƒe.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Kɔmitii kple kɔmitii kple kɔmitii siwo le ɖo: {groups}
